panes.title: Current session trace
panes.source:
(load-lain "propagators/compiler_2/runtime/lain/tracers.lain")

(define input 4)
(define result (let-cell [port] port))
(define traced (let-cell [port] port))

; Keep the explicit result connection visible to the current-session tracer.
(-> (+ input 1) result)

; trace reads this pane's current runtime-session graph.
(trace:session result :both traced)

(display traced)

panes.title: Live clock history
panes.source:
(load-primitive-environment "extensions/runtime_clock.clj")

(load-lain
  "propagators/compiler_2/runtime/lain/tracers.lain")

; The runtime publishes a new event value every 500 ms.
(define time
  (clock-in 500))

(display
  (trace:history time 0 60000))

panes.title: Potential and realized calls
panes.source:
(load-lain "propagators/compiler_2/runtime/lain/tracers.lain")

(define shift
  (network [x]
    (+ x 1)))

(define square
  (network [x]
    (* x x)))

(define pipeline
  (network [x]
    (square (shift x))))

; Realize the pipeline once so the graph contains both declared call sites
; and the applications connected by this execution.
; Datalog derives calls/called-by relationships and connects each closure and
; realized call frame to the shared central lexical environment.
(define result
  (pipeline 4))

(display
  (trace:calls pipeline))

panes.title: Rewrite quoted code
panes.source:
(load-lain "propagators/compiler_2/runtime/lain/tracers.lain")

; Replace the operator while retaining both operand expressions.
(define replace-operator
  (network [expression operator]
    (cons operator (cdr expression))))

(define units 6)
(define scope (current-environment))
(define expression '(+ units 2))
(define rewritten (replace-operator expression '*))

(define original-answer (eval expression scope))
(define rewritten-answer (eval rewritten scope))

; The same operands give 8 and 12. Inspect the evaluated result in this pane.
(display (trace:semantic rewritten-answer))
